answer: Cap each identity at 40 paid submissions per epoch and rotate the auditor pool each epoch, so no fixed graders certify a cluster. Each identity earns its pulse of paid work only after random auditors check its submissions against its record, and a proven duplicate freezes its payout and slashes its 200 POA bond in full. Idle identities stay cold as tundra: no graded history, zero influence, paid work only after three clean epochs. One exposed fake sends a ripple through its funding cluster, freezing every identity sharing its funder, so 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 POA, locked 90 days.
